newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-1997 Super 12 coaches confirmed.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-1997 Super 12 coaches confirmed.

text.p: Coaches and assistant coaches confirmed at today's New Zealand Rugby Football Union (NZRFU) board meeting for next year's Super 12 competition.
Coach - Glenn Ross, assistant coach - Keith Robertson.
Coach - Wayne Smith, assistant coach - Peter Sloane.
Coach - Frank Oliver, assistant coach - Graeme Taylor.
Coach - Brad Meurant, assistant coach - John Boe.
Coach - Graham Henry, assistant coach - Mac McCallion.
